desc: Anderson Manufacturing is excited to release the new AM-15 direct gas impingement Ar-15 semi auto rifle. This particular version comes standard with a rifle length free float hand guard. The hand guard features a full length top picatinny rail along with the modular Magpul M-LOK accessory attachment system. Built on a pair of standard forged upper/lower receivers this rifle is a cut above the rest. A standard A2 pistol grip and carbine collapsible stock round out the list of features, so don't delay pick one up today.
